_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional — delete what you don't need. config.json is gitignored.

labels._comment: index: 'folders' reads the list from disk, 'clio' from the Clio API, 'none' switches labels off entirely.

calendars._comment: Calendars whose events may name a label. Leave empty to switch attribution off.

reports._comment: Optional folder of pre-generated HTML reports to show in the panel. Leave dir null to hide the tab.
reports.label: Reports
